summary.fr: Philosophe allemand, auteur de la <w>Philosophie de la rédemption</w> : l'univers serait le cadavre d'un Dieu qui a voulu le néant, et toute chose tendrait vers sa propre extinction. Disciple radical de <ph id='schopenhauer'>Schopenhauer</ph>, il se donna la mort à la parution de son livre.
summary.en: German philosopher, author of the <w>Philosophy of Redemption</w>: the universe would be the corpse of a God who willed nothingness, and every thing would tend toward its own extinction. A radical disciple of <ph id='schopenhauer'>Schopenhauer</ph>, he took his own life as his book came out.
